name: [CODE-REVIEW] sender authenticity: From header trusted, no SPF/DKIM/DMARC check
observed: broker._matches/domain_matches use only the parsed From address. Gmail normally spam-folders spoofed mail, but anything delivered to INBOX with a forged From: noreply@<allowed-domain> (or a legit-but-compromised/forwarding sender, or a lookalike 'Reply-To' trick) is accepted as the OTP. Also kind=link returns attacker-chosen URLs on any allowlisted host.
fix: Require Authentication-Results: dkim=pass/dmarc=pass (Gmail adds it) with header.d aligned to sender_domains, and Return-Path/envelope domain consistent; skip messages in SPAM/with X-Gm-Spam
